finalText:
Built clean. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced undefined `retries` instead of `env.retries`. I added the default to the DEFAULTS object and fixed the reference to pull from the environment with a fallback.

Three warnings remain, but they're all intentional: deprecated API use, unused export, and a circular import. The build now finishes with 0 errors.
